$comment: One shard of the signal-lens catalogue. DATA, never loaded whole into an agent context. Validate with: python3 scripts/validate_catalogue.py

signals.name: Trial
signals.definition: The subject begins using the product itself under a time- or scope-limited arrangement - a self-serve free trial, a workspace created for evaluation, a sandbox or test key, or a sales-provisioned pilot or proof of concept. Qualifying condition: a trial or pilot instance is provisioned against a named account with a start timestamp and either an end date or a stated conversion condition.
signals.question_answered: Is this buyer evaluating with the product rather than about it, and is the evaluation actually progressing?

capability_ladder.how: Read the trial rows you already hold. Your auth or billing system already stores trial_start and trial_end - emit trial_started and trial_expiring as events keyed on the account, with no new instrumentation anywhere
requires: read access to the billing or auth database
capability_ladder.gives: A dated trial population and an expiry queue, today, for free

capability_ladder.how: Add exactly one activation milestone - the first in-product event that separates accounts that stay from accounts that leave - and count days active inside the trial window. A trial with zero activation is a lead, not a signal, and should be scored as one
requires: product event tracking and one agreed milestone definition
capability_ladder.gives: Separates real evaluation from a signup, which is the difference that makes this signal worth acting on

capability_ladder.how: Record seat invitations and the role of whoever sent them, so the trial stops being one person's experiment and becomes an observation about a buying group
requires: invitation events and a role or title field
capability_ladder.gives: Authority and group evidence from data the product already generates

min_data.note: An activation milestone chosen on fewer than roughly 200 converted trials is a guess dressed as a threshold; until then use days-active rather than a milestone.

access_conditions: This is your own service record about your own service; no third party gates any rung

Using in-product behaviour to drive sales outreach is a secondary purpose. It must appear in the notice the trial user accepted, and it should not extend to inspecting the content the user put into the product

freshness.note: The trial has a stated end date and the signal expires with it. After expiry without conversion the account becomes a lapsed-evaluation record, which is a different and much weaker thing.

false_positives: A competitor evaluating your product, which in software is routine rather than exceptional
A student, hobbyist, or job applicant using the trial to learn the tool
An agency or consultant trialling on behalf of a client who is the real buyer and may never appear
An existing customer's employee spinning up a second workspace because they cannot get access to the first
Serial trial accounts created to keep using the free window rather than to evaluate
Automated signups, disposable-domain registrations, and LLM agents completing signup flows
Internal staff testing after a release

signals.name: Sample request
signals.definition: The subject asks for a specimen of the product to assess before committing - a swatch, material or finish sample, tester, trial size, test print, spec sample, sample kit, or a scoped data extract standing in for the full product. Qualifying condition: a sample request or zero-value order record exists carrying the requested item identifiers and a fulfilment destination.
signals.question_answered: Which buyers have specified far enough to want the physical article in hand, and which items did they choose?

capability_ladder.how: Label the sample SKUs you already ship as a sample class in the catalogue. The orders are already in your commerce system; they are invisible only because a swatch and a sofa sit in the same order table with nothing distinguishing them
requires: a catalogue attribute and a one-off back-classification of existing SKUs
capability_ladder.gives: A countable sample population and the specific items each subject chose, retrospectively as well as going forward

capability_ladder.how: Record whether the sample was paid for and where it was sent - trade counter, site address, or residential. A paid sample and a free one are different commitments, and a sample sent to a site address is a live project
requires: destination classification on the fulfilment record
capability_ladder.gives: Splits the collectors from the specifiers without asking anyone a question

capability_ladder.how: Join sample orders to subsequent full orders on the same subject or project reference to measure your own sample-to-order lag, then set the follow-up window to that distribution rather than to a round number somebody guessed
requires: a subject or project key shared between sample and order records
capability_ladder.gives: A measured follow-up window, and the per-item conversion rates that tell you which samples to stop sending

min_data.note: A sample-to-order lag computed on fewer than roughly 100 matched pairs is noise; until then follow up on the item, not on a modelled window.

access_conditions: The whole path is inside systems you already run. The constraint is cost of goods and postage, not access

freshness.note: Sample requests run on the project's clock, not the browsing session's; in interiors and construction the meaningful window is months, in consumables it is days.

false_positives: Freebie collectors, who are the single largest contaminant of any free-sample programme and who request across your whole range rather than within one project
A competitor obtaining product for teardown, price benchmarking, or specification copying
Students and course participants requesting materials for portfolios, which is a very large share of sample volume in architecture, interiors, and design
A specifier or designer sampling on behalf of a client who may never buy, and who may specify a competitor
Press, reviewers, and content creators
An existing customer checking a new batch or dye lot against something already installed
Automated or scripted submissions harvesting free items

signals.name: Demo
signals.definition: The subject commits calendar time to a seller-led walkthrough of the product - a scheduled demo or live product tour, a showroom or in-store appointment, a test drive, or a site visit hosted by the seller. Qualifying condition: a held slot exists against the subject with a scheduled start, and the attendance outcome is recorded as held, no-show, rescheduled, or cancelled.
signals.question_answered: Which buyers have spent their own diary time on a seller-led evaluation, who came with them, and did they actually turn up?

capability_ladder.how: Write the outcome of every booked slot, not only the booking: held, no-show, rescheduled, cancelled. The scheduling tool already records the booking; the attendance field is the one almost always missing, and it is the field that carries the signal
requires: one status field on the meeting record and a rep habit or calendar sync to set it
capability_ladder.gives: Separates a demo from a diary entry, and produces a no-show recovery queue that did not exist before

capability_ladder.how: Store booking lead time and reschedule count. A slot booked for tomorrow and a slot booked five weeks out are different signals wearing the same name, and two reschedules is a negative signal that currently reads as neutral
requires: created-at and scheduled-at both retained
capability_ladder.gives: Urgency, at no cost, from two timestamps you already have

capability_ladder.how: Capture the attendee roster and map domains and titles to roles, so a demo becomes an observation about the buying group - who else came, whether anyone senior joined, and whether the champion brought a technical evaluator
requires: calendar attendee data and a role mapping
capability_ladder.gives: Authority and group evidence, which is the difference between a demo and a decision meeting

access_conditions: Attendee email addresses supplied by the organiser are personal data about people who never contacted you; store role and domain rather than building a contact record for every attendee by default
Recording a demo is a separate consent question from holding one, in both one-party and two-party consent jurisdictions

freshness.note: A held demo is at its most actionable in the days immediately after it; a booking that has not yet happened is a promise, not a commitment, and should not be scored as one.

false_positives: A competitor booking under a plausible name and domain, which is routine in software and in any category with hidden pricing
A third bid taken only to satisfy a procurement rule where the winner is already chosen
An analyst, journalist, or researcher gathering material
A job applicant preparing for an interview with you
An existing customer's team who want training and booked the demo form because it was the fastest route to a human
A prospective partner or reseller scoping a commercial relationship rather than a purchase
A student or a curious individual with no purchasing role
Bookings made by an assistant on behalf of someone who never attends

signals.name: Reservation
signals.definition: The subject takes a specific unit, slot, seat, or quantity off the market for themselves ahead of paying in full - a hold or waitlist deposit, a pre-order, a held appointment or delivery slot, a unit reserved at a dealership or showroom, or a cart backed by a reserved-inventory timer. Qualifying condition: a named inventory object enters a held state attributable to the subject, with a stated expiry or release condition.
signals.question_answered: Has this buyer taken a specific unit off the market for themselves, and when does that hold expire?

capability_ladder.how: Expose the hold expiry as a field rather than leaving it inside the scheduler. Nearly every booking, pre-order, and inventory-hold system stores the reservation and treats the expiry as an internal housekeeping detail - the expiry is the signal, because it is the only thing in this family that gives you a deadline to act against
requires: read access to the reservation or hold table
capability_ladder.gives: An expiring-hold queue, ranked by time remaining, from data you already have

capability_ladder.how: Band the deposit and record whether it is refundable. A refundable nominal hold and a non-refundable percentage deposit are different commitments and currently score identically
requires: the payment record joined to the hold
capability_ladder.gives: The single strongest discriminator inside this signal, at the cost of one join

capability_ladder.how: Reconcile holds against fulfilment to learn your own hold-to-purchase rate by channel and item, then treat holds in the segments that convert below that rate as the outreach queue and the rest as noise
requires: reservation and order records sharing a key
capability_ladder.gives: Stops you working every hold equally, which is how reservation programmes usually fail

access_conditions: Where the reservation is made on a marketplace rather than your own surface, the hold record and the buyer's contact details belong to the marketplace and are usually withheld; treat marketplace reservations as an aggregate demand signal, not a contactable one
signals.terms_note: Marketplace and platform terms routinely prohibit using reservation data to contact the buyer off-platform, independently of any privacy law.

freshness.note: The hold states its own expiry. After it lapses the signal is not weaker, it is over - and a lapsed hold is a distinct and useful negative observation.

false_positives: Speculative holds where holding costs nothing - multiple restaurant or appointment bookings for the same evening, or several units held while a decision is made
Resellers and scalpers reserving limited-release inventory to flip, and the bots that do it at scale
A hold placed purely to lock a price during an internal approval that may never come through
An assistant or family member holding a slot on someone else's behalf
Duplicate holds by the same person across channels, which inflate demand counts
A hold created by staff to protect stock for a walk-in customer who has not asked for it

signals.name: Consultation
signals.definition: The subject takes part in a scoped advisory session about their own situation rather than about the product - a discovery call, survey or site visit, design or fitting consultation, technical scoping session, or a paid assessment. Qualifying condition: a session takes place in which the subject supplies details of their own circumstances, and a written output exists against their record: notes, a scope, a drawing, a survey, or an estimate.
signals.question_answered: Has the buyer let us into their actual situation, and did the session produce a scope we can quote against?

capability_ladder.how: Record two fields on the sessions you already run: did it happen, and did it produce an artifact. A consultation with no scope, drawing, or estimate attached is a conversation, and separating those two populations needs no integration at all - a checkbox in the diary or CRM will do it
requires: the diary or CRM your team already books into
capability_ladder.gives: The distinction that matters most in this signal, obtainable this week even with a paper diary

capability_ladder.how: Add whether the subject paid for the session and whether it happened on their site. A paid consultation and a site visit both cost the buyer something real and both predict very differently from a free phone call
requires: a payment flag and a location type on the session record
capability_ladder.gives: Sorts genuine scoping from free advice without asking the buyer anything

capability_ladder.how: Connect the field-service, survey, or diary system so sessions held away from the office arrive as structured records rather than as a rep's memory, and carry the participant roles with them
requires: an export or connector from the field or scheduling system
capability_ladder.gives: Coverage of the sessions that matter most in services businesses, which are exactly the ones no CRM currently sees

access_conditions: Consultation notes are the most common route by which special-category detail enters a CRM as free text - a home survey records who lives there and how they live. Score the structured outcome fields and keep raw note text out of the scoring and audience path entirely

A site visit puts your staff in someone's home or premises; the record of that visit carries obligations that a web event does not, including retention limits and the occupant's rights over notes about them

freshness.note: A scope goes stale as the buyer's circumstances move; in services the useful window is the time it takes them to collect the other two quotes.

false_positives: Free consultations used as free advice - the buyer wanted the answer, not the service, and this is the dominant contaminant wherever consultations are free
A mandated second or third quote where the incumbent has already won
A tenant, occupant, or facilities contact who cannot authorise or fund the work
An insurance, warranty, or landlord-funded assessment where the person in the room is not paying
A competitor booking a consultation to learn your process, questions, and pricing structure
A homeowner gathering evidence for a claim or a dispute rather than a purchase
A session logged by a rep to show activity, with no artifact and no real meeting

signals.name: Consent and access granting
signals.definition: The subject gives the seller standing access to something of theirs so the evaluation can proceed - an authorised connection to a system they run, read access to a data or advertising account, a scoped API key, a guest login to their environment, a supplied export, or documented site access for a survey. Qualifying condition: an access grant is recorded against the subject with a scope, a grant timestamp, and a revocation state.
signals.question_answered: Has this buyer done the internally expensive thing of giving us access to their own systems, and is that access still live?

capability_ladder.how: Log the act of granting as a first-class event with its scope and timestamp. Every integration stores the resulting token and almost none store the grant - yet the grant, the delay before it, and the revocation are the signal, and the token is not
requires: one event write in the authorisation callback you already run
capability_ladder.gives: A commitment event and a revocation event from code that already executes

capability_ladder.how: Record who granted it and whether an administrator had to unlock it. A grant that required an admin to intervene is evidence of internal authority and of a real evaluation, not of one curious user
requires: the granting identity and any approval step retained
capability_ladder.gives: Authority evidence that no amount of web tracking will produce

capability_ladder.how: Monitor connection health and revocation as a suppression signal. A revoked or broken grant that the subject does not restore is one of very few reliable negative signals a seller ever receives, and it should stop outreach rather than trigger it
requires: a periodic connection check and a route into suppression
capability_ladder.gives: The negative half of the signal, which is usually discarded

access_conditions: Use data reached through a granted connection only for the purpose the subject was told about. Deriving unrelated attributes from it is a purpose-limitation breach and, for special-category attributes, a prohibited class - see restricted.granted_access_secondary_inference

Platform API programmes impose limited-use terms that survive the user's consent. The user cannot consent you out of the platform's contract, and the platform's approval is a separate gate from the user's
A connected mailbox, file store, or calendar contains other people's personal data. A lawful basis for the grantor is not a lawful basis for everyone whose data sits inside what they granted
Take the narrowest scope that answers the question, and revoke it yourself when the evaluation ends
signals.terms_note: Platform limited-use policies and API terms constrain what may be done with granted data independently of the user's consent, and breach of them is a contractual and access risk rather than only a privacy one.

freshness.note: The grant is a state, not an event: it stays true until revoked. The intent it evidenced decays but the access does not, so score the recency of the grant separately from the current state of the connection.

false_positives: A technical evaluator granting read-only access with genuine curiosity and no budget or authority
An agency or managed-service provider connecting a client's account, so the grantor is a proxy and the buyer is elsewhere
A grant made solely to obtain a free audit or report, with the connection revoked as soon as the report arrives
An existing customer reconnecting after a token expiry, which reads as a new grant and is not new intent
A partner or integrator connecting for their own build or certification testing
Internal staff connecting a test account
A grant made by one team while another team has already selected a different supplier

signals.name: Seller inventory allocation
signals.definition: The seller commits scarce resource of its own to one named buyer - stock ring-fenced, a production or installation slot booked, a specialist or engineer assigned, a bespoke sample or prototype made, a quote priced by a human rather than a calculator, or a discount approval consumed. Qualifying condition: an internal record shows a scarce resource reserved, assigned, or spent against a named opportunity, with a release or expiry condition.
signals.question_answered: Which opportunities has our own organisation already spent scarce capacity on, and is that capacity about to be released?

capability_ladder.how: Count the human hours your own organisation has already spent on the opportunity, using records that already exist: a quote priced by a person rather than generated, a discount approval raised, a bespoke drawing produced. One weekly export of these against the opportunity id is enough to rank a pipeline by what you have already invested in it
requires: a weekly export from the quoting, approval, or job system
capability_ladder.gives: The seller's own revealed belief, which no buyer-side signal can substitute for, at the cost of one report

capability_ladder.how: Add the physical allocations - stock held, a slot in the production or installation schedule, an engineer assigned - and record the release condition alongside each
requires: the inventory or scheduling system joined to the opportunity id
capability_ladder.gives: A release queue: capacity you are holding for deals that are not moving

capability_ladder.how: Band the cost of each allocation so a two-hour quote and a fortnight of engineering do not score the same, and require an explicit release so stale allocations stop inflating both the forecast and this signal
requires: a cost band per resource type and a release step someone owns
capability_ladder.gives: Makes the signal survive contact with a sales team, which is where it usually dies

access_conditions: This is the seller's own operational data about itself, so no privacy permission gates it; the cost is entirely integration effort into systems that were never built to be read this way
Allocation records are commercially sensitive internally - a discount approval level exposed to the buyer becomes a negotiating position

freshness.note: Where the allocation carries an explicit release date, treat that date as a hard expiry instead; the decay here covers the common case of allocations that nobody ever formally releases.

false_positives: Speculative allocation by a representative protecting a forecast, which is pipeline theatre rather than evidence about the buyer
Standing allocations that belong to an existing customer's running contract and were never intended as a new-deal signal
Resource assigned to a support escalation or a warranty claim rather than to a sale
Allocation made at a partner's or distributor's request when the end buyer has not asked for anything
Stale records - capacity held for a deal that died months ago and that nobody released
Internal builds, demonstration units, and trade-show stock recorded against a placeholder account
Allocation driven by a supply constraint - stock held because it is scarce, not because a buyer is close

signals.name: Time investment escalation
signals.definition: The effort a subject spends on the seller's surfaces steps up relative to that subject's own prior baseline, rather than merely being high. Qualifying condition: a declared effort measure - session minutes, documentation depth, meeting minutes held, thread length, or distinct participants - rises by a stated multiple over the subject's own trailing baseline within a stated window. A subject who has always been heavily engaged does not qualify; a threshold crossed is not an escalation.
signals.question_answered: Is this buyer accelerating, and did the acceleration start before or after we touched them?

capability_ladder.how: Compute the escalation on one measure you already hold - logged-in session minutes, or distinct documentation pages read per week - and compare each subject against its own trailing eight-week median rather than against a global threshold. The comparison is the work; the data is already there
requires: eight weeks of per-subject history on one measure
capability_ladder.gives: An acceleration list rather than a most-active list, which are different populations

capability_ladder.how: Add the human-time measures your CRM already stores and nobody aggregates: meeting minutes held, email thread depth, distinct people involved. Human minutes cost the buyer far more than page views and should be weighted accordingly
requires: meeting and activity records with durations
capability_ladder.gives: Effort measured in the buyer's scarcest resource instead of in clicks

capability_ladder.how: Attribute the escalation: flag whether it began within N days of a seller-initiated touch, so you can distinguish demand from the echo of your own campaign
requires: outbound touch timestamps joined to the same subject
capability_ladder.gives: The only rung that stops this signal measuring your own marketing back to you

min_data.note: Without a per-subject baseline this degenerates into an engagement score. Below roughly 500 subjects with three observed periods each, the multiple cannot be distinguished from ordinary week-to-week variance and should not be published as a signal.

access_conditions: Session-replay and on-site-search implementations are the specific behavioural-telemetry patterns drawing wiretapping-style claims in the US; prefer aggregate duration and page-count measures over replay for this signal
Compute the escalation on aggregates. This signal needs the shape of a subject's effort over time, not a transcript of what they read

freshness.note: An acceleration is only news while it is still accelerating; a sustained new level is a baseline, not a signal, and should be re-based rather than re-scored.

false_positives: Your own campaign creating the escalation you then read as demand - the dominant failure of this signal and the reason rung 3 exists
An existing customer with a support problem generating heavy engagement that looks identical to buying behaviour
One power user changing habits, mistaken for an account moving
Calendar effects hitting every subject at once - quarter close, budget season, a conference week - which raise the whole population and register as many simultaneous escalations
Crawlers, scrapers and LLM agents inflating page and session counts on documentation
A competitor or analyst conducting a deep review over a short period
A new employee at the account onboarding themselves through your material
Renewal-season activity by an account that is leaving and is reading the exit documentation
